figurative_meaning_en: Various small and large percussion instruments of the dhol family

example_sentences_in_english: With the playing of various drums, a new group was born.

history: Refers to traditional Bengali percussion instruments used in folk music and celebrations, originating from rural musical traditions.
note: The idiom evokes the chaotic yet lively sounds of multiple drums, often associated with communal events in Bengali culture.
